summary: P0 RETEST wave7 email_verified fix. Re-ran test_wave7_growth.py (16/16 PASS) and test_wave6_auth_email.py (3/3 PASS) after loading backend/.env into shell so MongoClient tests can read MONGO_URL. Manual smoke via curl confirmed GET /api/community/users/me now returns key 'email_verified': false and 'email_verified_at': null immediately after Email/Password register, and wave7::test_verify_confirm_flow verifies that after POST /verify/confirm the same endpoint returns 'email_verified': true. Emergent Google Auth path (_upsert_user_from_identity sets email_verified=true) is now surfaced via the same _to_public serializer. Fix in models_profile.py (ProfilePublic gains email_verified + email_verified_at) and profile_routes.py::_to_public (copies both fields with sane defaults) works as intended. No regressions.

minor.issue: Test uses os.environ['MONGO_URL'] directly (Mongo backdoor to fetch reset token). Under pytest-xdist workers the parent shell env is not propagated unless MONGO_URL is exported before invoking pytest. Not a product bug — just a test harness ergonomics gotcha. Suggest loading backend/.env via python-dotenv in conftest.py or wrapping with pytest-dotenv.

action_items: Optional (dev-ex): add python-dotenv load or pytest-dotenv in /app/backend/tests/conftest.py so tests that reach into Mongo directly work without needing `set -a && . backend/.env` shell prelude.
critical_code_review_comments: ProfilePublic model_config still uses extra='ignore'; consider a smoke test that snapshots the /me response shape so future user-level flags don't silently disappear again (regression guard for the class of bug fixed here).

profile_routes._to_public defaults email_verified to False via bool(user.get('email_verified', False)) — correct. Just note: for legacy users predating email verification the flag will read False even if they authenticated via Google before the field was introduced. Consider a one-shot migration to mark existing google-provider users as verified=true (already handled going forward by _upsert_user_from_identity).

success_rate.backend: 100% (19/19 with env loaded; 18/19 without MONGO_URL exported — same environmental caveat as iter_18)

seed_data_creation: Each test creates ephemeral users via /api/community/auth/register.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Wave7 email_verified bug (iter_18) is fully resolved. All wave6+wave7 backend tests green. Only lingering item is pytest env ergonomics (MONGO_URL not auto-loaded for tests that hit Mongo directly). No code fixes needed on product surface.
rca of the issue: N/A — fix from iter_18 confirmed working. Root cause was ProfilePublic pydantic model missing email_verified field with extra='ignore' silently stripping it; adding the field + copying it in _to_public restores the flag in the JSON response.
